_comment: Hand-labelled PILOT sentences for masker recall (S1.3, FR-140): real sentences from the G2C life-events pages (tools/g2c_demo snapshot, 2026-10-05), labelled by hand without consulting the masker. Every phone number, personal email and personal name is replaced by a synthetic value of the same shape; institutional addresses and public URLs are kept. An entity counts as protected only when one masked span covers all of it (a whole phone number with its area code, a whole time). 'tune' may guide pattern changes; 'heldout' must not, and is the recall gate. Splits alternate and were fixed before the first run.
